description: S45 T2 (PM6): policy.vocabulary serves the closed picture from the ONE daemon-side source so no client hardcodes it — the four closed sets as types.go names them, the authorship matrix COMPUTED by calling checkAuthorship for each (source, action) pair (never restated: the refused cells carry the boundary's PL1 sentence verbatim, so a UI that paraphrases it is a second PL1), and one spec descriptor per compiled type taken from the registered validator's schema — the same field set the write refuses anything outside. A UI form built from anything else drifts from the engine; built from this, an offered value is an accepted value.
